documentation.description:
Generated by tools/gen-tldr.py from docs/tldr/adacovex.md -- the
bundled tldr page that `adacovex tldr` installs into a local tldr
client (tealdeer custom pages, or a base client's cache pages tree).
Edit docs/tldr/adacovex.md and run `just build` (or `just
tldr-check` to verify); do not edit this file by hand.

constants.name: Page
constants.code:
Page : constant String :=
"# adacovex"
& ASCII.LF
& "> Coverage, proof, and compliance assessment tool for Ada an"
& "d SPARK projects."
& ASCII.LF
& "> More information: <https://github.com/bladeacer/adacovex>."
& ASCII.LF
& ASCII.LF
& "- Assess the current project and print the report:"
& ASCII.LF
& "`adacovex`"
& ASCII.LF
& ASCII.LF
& "- Assess a project at another path:"
& ASCII.LF
& "`adacovex --target={{path/to/project}}`"
& ASCII.LF
& ASCII.LF
& "- Assess against a compliance standard and tier:"
& ASCII.LF
& "`adacovex --standard {{dal-c}}`"
& ASCII.LF
& ASCII.LF
& "- Run SPARK proofs, then assess the result:"
& ASCII.LF
& "`adacovex prove`"
& ASCII.LF
& ASCII.LF
& "- Serve the results as a web dashboard:"
& ASCII.LF
& "`adacovex --serve`"
& ASCII.LF
& ASCII.LF
& "- Check SPARK proof coverage:"
& ASCII.LF
& "`adacovex spark-coverage`"
& ASCII.LF
& ASCII.LF
& "- Install the man page into the local man database:"
& ASCII.LF
& "`adacovex man`"
& ASCII.LF
& ASCII.LF
& "- Install the built-in cheat sheet into the local tldr clien"
& "t:"
& ASCII.LF
& "`adacovex tldr --check`"
& ASCII.LF
& ASCII.LF
& "- Generate an SBOM:"
& ASCII.LF
& "`adacovex sbom`"
& ASCII.LF;
